# Helios signs
Set H-6 needs one cell per distinct letter of the modern Greek alphabet. Uppercase and lowercase share a cell; final sigma is a variant, not an extra letter. Select the lowest-cost enabled rack with enough cells.

turns.prompt: Read the Helios sign files. Search for the number of distinct letters in the modern Greek alphabet, using the variant rule in the brief. For H-6, select the cheapest enabled rack that can hold the alphabet and calculate how many cells remain empty. Save the selected rack ID to type/selected-rack.txt and the empty-cell count to type/empty-cells.txt, each as one value on one line. Use a decimal integer for the count. Tell me the rack and count, and keep all existing files unchanged.

turns.final: H-6 should use RK-25. The modern Greek alphabet has 24 letters, leaving 1 empty cell in the 25-cell rack. Saved the rack ID and empty-cell count to the requested files.
